items.label: Shelf life
items.text: SikaBond® FoamFix+ has a shelf life of 9 months from the date of production, if stored properly in undamaged, original, sealed packaging, and if the storage conditions are met. Opened cans of SikaBond® FoamFix+ must be used within 4 weeks.

items.label: Storage conditions
items.text: SikaBond® FoamFix+ shall be stored in an upright position, in dry conditions, protected from direct sunlight and at temperatures between +5 °C and +25 °C.

items.label: Ambient air temperature
items.text:
Optimum | +18 °C min. / +25 °C max.
Permissable | +5 °C min. / +30 °C max.

items.label: Substrate temperature
items.text:
Optimum | +18 °C min. / +25 °C max.
Permissable | +5 °C min. / +30 °C max.

items.label: Cutting time
items.text: ~12 min (after which a 20 mm bead of SikaBond® FoamFix+ can be cut). SikaBond® FoamFix+ is fully cured after 12 h.

items.label: Yield
items.text:
750 ml can of SikaBond® FoamFix+ | ~10 m2, styrofoam plate fixing ~30 m, straw cross-section 30 x 30 mm
Consumption can be regulated by adjusting the pressure on the trigger.

items.label: APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS
items.text: For the application of SikaBond® FoamFix+ all generally accepted rules of building and construction apply.

items.label: SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
items.text: The substrate must be clean, sound and homogeneous, free from oils, grease, dust and loose or friable particles. Paint, cement laitance and other poorly adhering contaminants must be removed. SikaBond® FoamFix+ adheres without primers and/or activators. Pre-dampen the substrate with clean water, this ensures that the foam cures properly and also prevents secondary foam expansion.

items.label: CLEANING OF EQUIPMENT
items.text: Clean all tools and application equipment immediately with Sika Boom®-Cleaner and/or Sika® Remover-208. Once cured, residual material can only be removed mechanically.
